Ultimate-owned, framework-agnostic reimplementation of PrimeVue BaseComponent's _loadThemeStyles() two-tier theme-variable loading (common primitive/semantic/global tier loaded once globally; per-component variable tier loaded once per component name, both idempotently guarded). Reshaped from PrimeVue's Vue-component-method form into a plain function taking a uix-styled StyleSheet, so ng-core/react-core/vue-core can each drive it from their own existing structural-CSS registration call site. Excludes PrimeVue's isUnstyled/$theme==='none' short-circuits and its BaseStyle/$styleOptions indirection.
